overview_description.description:
Egypt’s 1st startup company to develop an auction marketplace for property rentals in the MENA region.  

Rentup is an Egyptian proptech startup which offers both an online auction marketplace and traditional marketplace for property rentals in Egypt. By bringing the theory of negotiation online, Rentup has transformed the overall experience and process between tenants and property owners through Rentup's unique interface which adds visibility, transparency, flexibility and diversity between both parties.
www.rentup.com.eg
